player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kadi ya mpinzani wako ni: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pesa moja tu ya kitendo kilichowekwa mabano, kwa mfano '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', au '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Kakuena tshintu tshia kubikila; udi mua [check] pa muaba wa nanku.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Kuenza mudimu ne [bet X] bua kuangula; kakuena mushindu wa kuteka makuta a bungi to.
invalid_move.insufficient: Kuena ne biamu bia bungi bua bualu ebu to.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: both {card}. Pot split – each receives {split}.
